Bots Tracker Rules Settings
Settings
Connect Interactive Brokers

Connect Interactive Brokers

  1. Download these three files — you will upload them when you register a consumer at IBKR:

    Signing public key Encryption public key Diffie-Hellman params

  2. Register your key on IBKR’s OAuth self-service portal — pick a consumer key of exactly 9 letters (A–Z). Follow these three steps in order; this is where almost every failed setup goes wrong:

    1. Open the portal in a private/incognito window, and log in to the IBKR account you want to connect — not another account you happen to have.
    2. Once you are logged in, look at your browser’s address bar. It has to read ndcdyn.interactivebrokers.com or www.interactivebrokers.co.uk. IBKR sometimes redirects you elsewhere while you log in — if the address is any other interactivebrokers.* domain, close the tab and open the other portal link below. The file upload only works on those two.
    3. Set your Consumer Key, upload the three files you downloaded above, then come back here and paste the credentials IBKR gives you.
    Open IBKR portal Open the other portal

    “Failed to set Key - failed to put consumer info” (error 501) means you are on an IBKR server that blocks the upload — not that you did anything wrong. Go back and use the other portal link.

    IBKR keeps only ONE key registration per login. Saving the portal form again later replaces it and breaks the connection you already have — once you are connected, do not reopen the portal.

  3. Paste the Consumer Key, Access Token and Access Token Secret IBKR gives you:

    The 9-letter key (A–Z) you chose and saved in the portal’s Consumer Key box — it stays saved on your IBKR account and is shown at the top of the portal’s Configuration page.
